app_identifier.description: The app being logged in to, as its globally unique identifier — the lowercase, underscore-separated string the developer chose when the app was created. There is no organisation context at login, so this is what decides which app the credentials are checked for.

email.description: The end user's email address. Addresses are global across Fleetless rather than per app, so one person is one identity however many apps they reach.

password.description: The end user's password. A wrong pair is refused without saying which half was wrong, so a failed login is not an account-enumeration oracle.
